servicesPreview.description: From head to toe, we offer a comprehensive range of beauty treatments designed to make you look and feel your best.

homeVsSalon.title: Your Comfort, Your Choice
homeVsSalon.homeDesc: Enjoy our professional beauty services in the comfort of your own home. Perfect for henna, bridal packages, and group bookings.
homeVsSalon.salonDesc: Visit our beautifully designed salon in Al Mu'tarid for the full pampering experience with all our premium equipment and products.

items.text: Mizhi is my go-to salon! The staff is incredibly professional and the atmosphere makes me feel so relaxed. Their facials are absolutely amazing.
items.author: Sarah A.

items.text: Best henna service in Al Ain! They came to my home for my engagement party and every design was stunning. Highly recommend their home service.
items.author: Fatima K.

items.text: The hair treatments here are top notch. My hair has never looked better after the protein treatment. The team really knows what they're doing.
items.author: Aisha M.

aboutPage.title: About Mizhi
aboutPage.story: Mizhi Ladies Salon was founded with a simple vision — to create a beautiful, private sanctuary where women can relax, rejuvenate, and feel their absolute best. Located in the heart of Al Mu'tarid, Al Ain, our salon is designed to provide a luxurious and comfortable experience for every client.
aboutPage.womenOnlyDesc: Your privacy and comfort are our top priority. Mizhi is an exclusively women-only salon, ensuring a safe and relaxing space for all our clients.
aboutPage.teamDesc: Our team of skilled beauticians brings years of experience and a passion for beauty to every treatment.
aboutPage.contactDesc: We'd love to hear from you. Reach out for bookings, inquiries, or feedback.
